_README: Seeded once by the AI-Handbook sync, then owned by this repository. EDIT BOTH FIELDS BEFORE USE. Left as-is, the machinery refuses rather than guesses: the placeholder below is rejected by name the moment a budget is declared, with a message naming this file -- so no budget, and therefore no review round, can exist under it. A review request posted before any budget exists refuses for lack of a budget and says to declare one, which is where the placeholder is caught. That is the intended failure -- it announces itself instead of silently protecting nothing.
_repo: This repository's GitHub owner/name, exactly as the API spells it. Read from this file, stamped into every receipt and record the machinery writes, and compared back on every one it reads -- and against every GitHub snapshot, so a snapshot of the wrong PR is refused. A wrong value is a mistake the machinery catches by refusing, with a message naming both values. It is not a security boundary: the person who can edit this file is the person running the scripts.
_contractBudgets: The contract files loaded into EVERY Claude Code session, each pinned to its EXACT current size in lines and bytes. Seeded at 0/0 deliberately: the check refuses until they are pinned, and its failure message names the real numbers, so the first run tells you what to write. The exactness is the mechanism -- a budget with room left is satisfied by the very state it exists to prevent, so being UNDER budget fails too, and re-pinning is a visible one-line diff in a pull request. Add an entry for every file a session loads unconditionally; drop one that this repository does not have.
_requiredChecks: The CI jobs that must be PRESENT before a readiness receipt is honest -- every job that can appear late, not only the ones that must pass. A job gated on an earlier one is created late, so a snapshot taken too early sees a complete green set without it. Use the jobs.*.name values from this repo's workflows. Read from this file; a pull request that changes it is judged by what it commits, and that change is in the diff. An empty list is refused.
